How do I earn a certificate?

Practise a level until you have answered at least 30 of its questions (or all of them, if there are fewer), with at least %1$d%% of your latest answers correct. Wrong answers can be fixed with “Review mistakes”.
The level\'s final exam then unlocks: %1$d random questions in %2$d minutes, marked on the server.
Score %1$d%% or more and your certificate is issued at once, as a PDF with a QR code anyone can scan to check it.
Did not pass? Review your mistakes; the next attempt opens after %1$d hours.
